text:
Hi :)) I am currently trying to figure out how to join the partner insurance plan at Meuhedet and have 3 questions that hopefully one of you could help me with: 

1) Does anybody know where I can get some form of official statement that the partner insurance comes at a reduced price? So that in case I come across a clerk that does not know about it, I have some official document and not just the blog post of AIC. 

2) Is a shared notary affidavit about a common-law partnership (“Yeduim Batzibur” status) really necessary, or could my partner and I simply present our official B/1 partner visa documents from MH as proof? 

3) Can I go to any clinic or is it best to go to my partner's home branch or the one in Florentin? 

If you have any other advice/ experience to share regarding wait times or processing times, I'd be super grateful, too!

Thanks a bunch in advance!
